instruction: Compute the mean of the 'Spent ($)' column and record the result in cell C10, rounded to two decimal places.

metadata.explanation: Task requires calculating the average of column C (Spent) from rows 2-8 and placing it in C10 with two decimal places. Verified with Python: average = 288.09 / 7 = 41.15571... which rounds to 41.16 (two decimal places). The evaluator reads cell C10 after saving and compares against 41.16 with 0.01 tolerance.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 1.0 if cell C10 contains the correct average (41.16 ± 0.01), 0.0 otherwise
